name: Tenant isolation
verification: Estimate values, vendor quotes, custom rates and overrides cannot cross tenant boundaries.

name: Approval segregation
verification: Approval policy may prevent estimate preparer from self-approving above configured thresholds.

name: Override authority
verification: Protected price/rate/markup overrides require explicit entitlement and reason.

name: AI boundary
verification: AI estimate assistance cannot directly approve, freeze, export as authoritative, or write published library data.

name: Calculation input validation
verification: Units, numeric ranges and required snapshot references validate before calculation.

name: Quote confidentiality
verification: Vendor/customer-specific pricing follows role and project permissions.

name: Audit visibility
verification: Calculation and override audit detail is permission scoped.

name: Frozen immutability
verification: Approved/frozen estimate versions reject direct mutation.

name: Export authority
verification: Proposal/job baseline export requires approved scope/status per tenant policy.

name: Service writeback control
verification: Estimator writeback requires catalog permission and governed review.

name: Evidence access
verification: Plan/spec/quote evidence follows source document permissions.
